name: Deny by default
summary: Nothing is allowed until a rule allows it.
description: Denies every request. Start here and insert or write the rules that allow what you need.
rules: default allow := false

docs.label: Concept: default allow vs default deny

name: Require authenticated caller
summary: Allow only callers that authenticated.
description: Allows a request only when the caller authenticated with one of the surface's Caller Context methods. Denies callers whose credential was missing or invalid, and requests on a surface without caller authentication.

name: Allow by JWT claim or role
summary: Allow only JWT callers whose claim has one of the listed values.
description: Allows a request when the caller authenticated with a JWT and the chosen claim, such as role, holds one of the listed values. A claim that is a list matches when any of its values is listed. Denies every other caller.

parameters.label: Claim
parameters.help: The JWT claim to check, for example role, roles or groups.

parameters.label: Allowed values
parameters.help: Separate values with commas.

docs.label: Guide: Use JWT claims to control access

name: Allow by JWT issuer and audience
summary: Allow only tokens from listed issuers for listed audiences.
description: Allows a request only when the caller's JWT was issued by one of the listed issuers and names one of the listed audiences. Denies every other caller.

parameters.label: Allowed issuers
parameters.help: Exact iss values, separated by commas.

parameters.label: Allowed audiences
parameters.help: Exact aud values, separated by commas.

name: Restrict MCP tools by role
summary: Admins call any tool; other callers only the safe tools.
description: Allows callers with an admin role to call any MCP tool, other authenticated callers to call only the listed safe tools, and authenticated callers to use other MCP methods such as tools/list. Use it as the whole policy: inserted into another policy it would allow requests that policy denies.

parameters.label: Admin roles
parameters.help: Values of the JWT role claim that may call any tool, separated by commas.

parameters.label: Safe tools
parameters.help: MCP tools every authenticated caller may call, separated by commas.

docs.label: Concept: restrict tool access by role

name: Require Trust Registry recognition
summary: Allow only agents the Trust Registry recognises.
description: Allows a request only when the calling agent has a DID and the Trust Registry recognised it. Needs Extract Trust Registry Data on the surface; without it input.agent is absent and every request is denied.

name: Require verified credential subject
summary: Allow only listed caller DIDs the gateway verified.
description: Allows a request only when the gateway verified the caller's DID, from an identity presentation or a bound source credential, and that DID is on the list. Denies unverified and unlisted callers.

parameters.label: Allowed DIDs
parameters.help: Caller DIDs, separated by commas.

name: Allowlist outbound destinations
summary: Allow outbound calls only to the listed destinations.
description: Allows a Transit Point call only when its destination starts with one of the listed prefixes. Inbound requests are allowed. Use it as the whole policy: inserted into another policy it would allow requests that policy denies.

parameters.label: Allowed destination prefixes
parameters.help: Start of each allowed destination URL, separated by commas.

name: Allow during business hours
summary: Allow requests only on listed days between two hours.
description: Allows a request only on the listed weekdays, from the start hour until the end hour, in the chosen time zone. Rate limits are set on the surface's Rate Limit panel, not in policy.

parameters.label: Days
parameters.help: English day names, separated by commas.

parameters.label: From hour
parameters.help: First allowed hour, 0 to 23.

parameters.label: Until hour
parameters.help: Requests are allowed until this hour starts. Must be later than From hour.

parameters.label: Time zone
parameters.help: An IANA time zone, for example Europe/Berlin or Asia/Singapore.

name: All trust checks pass
summary: Allow only if every trust check succeeded.
description: Allows a request only if at least one trust check ran on the target and every one succeeded. Denies when any check failed or none ran.

name: At least N trust checks pass
summary: Threshold instead of all-or-nothing. Has a setting.
description: Allows a request when the number of passing trust checks on the target reaches your threshold. Denies when fewer pass, or when no checks ran.

parameters.label: Minimum passing checks
parameters.help: Updates the Rego below. You can still edit the code after using the template.

name: Allow listed HTTP methods
summary: Allow only the listed HTTP methods.
description: Allows a request only when its HTTP method is on the list, for example to keep a surface read-only.
rules:
default allow := false

allow if input.http.method in {{methods}}

parameters.label: Allowed methods
parameters.help: Upper case, separated by commas.

name: Allow listed paths
summary: Allow only requests under the listed path prefixes.
description: Allows a request only when its path starts with one of the listed prefixes. Denies a path that contains .., %2e, a backslash or %5c.

parameters.label: Allowed path prefixes
parameters.help: Separate prefixes with commas.

name: Allow listed surfaces
summary: Allow only requests to the listed surfaces.
description: Allows a request only when it is for one of the listed surfaces, by name. Useful for a policy enforced across every surface.
rules:
default allow := false

allow if input.channel.name in {{surfaces}}

parameters.label: Surface names
parameters.help: Surface names, separated by commas.

name: Allow listed subjects
summary: Allow only the listed JWT subjects.
description: Allows a request only when the caller authenticated with a JWT whose subject is on the list. Denies every other caller.

parameters.label: Allowed subjects
parameters.help: Separate subjects with commas.

name: Monitor-only baseline
summary: Lets everything through. For observing traffic only.
description: Allows every request, so you can watch traffic before writing a stricter policy: through the Audit Log when policy decisions are audited, or through policy input capture. To try a stricter policy without blocking, use the Monitor option of global enforcement on the Policies list instead.
rules: default allow := true

docs.label: Concept: default allow vs default deny

name: Tool policy: allow authenticated callers
summary: For a tool binding: allow any caller with a token.
description: For a policy bound to MCP tools on the MCP Proxy hop: allows a call when the caller's token has a subject.
rules:
default allow := false

allow if input.jwt.sub

name: Tool policy: allow by JWT claim
summary: For a tool binding: allow callers whose claim has a listed value.
description: For a policy bound to MCP tools on the MCP Proxy hop: allows a call when a claim in the caller's token, a single value or a list, has one of the listed values. Covers admin-only and subscription-based access.

parameters.label: Claim
parameters.help: The token claim to read, for example role or subscription.

parameters.label: Allowed values
parameters.help: Values of the claim, separated by commas.

name: Tool policy: admin role with a deny reason
summary: For a tool binding: allow one role and record why others were denied.
description: For a policy bound to MCP tools on the MCP Proxy hop: allows callers with the admin role and sets deny_reason when the token has no role or another role. The reason is written to the audit log only, not the response.

parameters.label: Allowed role
parameters.help: The role claim value that may call the tool.

name: Tool policy: allow every caller
summary: For a tool binding: the tool entry list is the only control.
description: For a policy bound to MCP tools on the MCP Proxy hop: allows every call, so only the tools listed on the binding decide what can be called.
rules: default allow := true
